enriched.title: Passado Simples e Contínuo com Verbos Irregulares
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do passado simples e do passado contínuo, incluindo frases de prática controlada em diferentes contextos, como negócios e situações do dia a dia. Além disso, são apresentados verbos irregulares comuns e vocabulário relacionado ao tema.
mainTopics: Vocabulário relacionado ao cotidiano e negócios

vocabulary.definition: An increase in the Earth's average surface temperature due to greenhouse gases.
examples: Global warming is a serious issue for the environment.

vocabulary.definition: To produce a sound, typically by striking a bell or similar object.
examples: The fire alarm rang loudly.
The phone is ringing.

vocabulary.definition: To produce musical tones with the voice.
examples: She sang beautifully at the concert.
I sing in a choir every Sunday.

vocabulary.definition: To move through water using the arms and legs.
examples: We swam across the lake.
She swims every morning.

vocabulary.definition: To acquire something in exchange for money.
examples: She bought a new dress yesterday.
I buy groceries every week.

vocabulary.definition: To seize or take hold of something.
examples: He caught the ball just in time.
I caught a taxi to work.

vocabulary.definition: To engage in a struggle or battle.
examples: They fought bravely in the war.
Stop fighting and talk it out.

vocabulary.definition: To block or become stuck, preventing movement.
examples: The machine jammed while the intern was photocopying the documents.
The music stopped abruptly.

vocabulary.definition: A question word used to ask about a location.
examples: Where are you going?

vocabulary.definition: To have clothing, jewelry, etc., on your body.
examples: What are you wearing to the party?

grammar.explanation: The past simple is used to talk about completed actions in the past, while the past continuous is used to describe actions that were in progress at a specific time in the past.
rules: Use the past simple for actions that happened and finished in the past (e.g., 'I went to the store.').
Use the past continuous for actions that were ongoing at a particular time (e.g., 'I was reading when he called.').
Combine past simple and past continuous to describe an interruption (e.g., 'I was watching TV when she arrived.').
examples: The sun was shining brightly when we arrived at the beach.
Something went wrong while the scientist was conducting the experiment.
Everyone was dancing at the party when the music stopped abruptly.
The project manager entered the room while the developers were debating the software architecture.
The marketing team was brainstorming new ideas when the fire alarm rang.
commonMistakes: Using past simple instead of past continuous for an ongoing action (e.g., 'I read when he called' instead of 'I was reading when he called.').
Forgetting to use 'was' or 'were' with the -ing form in the past continuous (e.g., 'The sun shining brightly' instead of 'The sun was shining brightly.').

practiceQuestions.question: The sun / shine / brightly / when / we / arrive / at the beach.
practiceQuestions.answer: The sun was shining brightly when we arrived at the beach.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The past continuous ('was shining') is used to describe the ongoing action, while the past simple ('arrived') indicates the interruption.

practiceQuestions.question: The marketing team / brainstorm / new ideas / when / the fire alarm / ring.
practiceQuestions.answer: The marketing team was brainstorming new ideas when the fire alarm rang.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The ongoing action ('was brainstorming') is in the past continuous, while the interrupting action ('rang') is in the past simple.

practiceQuestions.question: While / the intern / photocopy / the documents / the machine / jam.
practiceQuestions.answer: While the intern was photocopying the documents, the machine jammed.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The action of photocopying (past continuous) was interrupted by the machine jamming (past simple).

culturalNotes: O uso do passado contínuo em inglês é semelhante ao uso do pretérito imperfeito em português.
Os verbos irregulares em inglês não seguem um padrão fixo, sendo necessário memorizá-los com prática contínua.
studyTips: Pratique a conjugação de verbos irregulares montando frases simples no passado.
Leia as frases de exemplo em voz alta para melhorar sua pronúncia e fluência.
Tente criar suas próprias frases usando o passado simples e o passado contínuo em diferentes contextos.
originalExamples: The sun was shining brightly when we arrived at the beach. (O sol estava brilhando intensamente quando nós chegamos na praia.)
Something went wrong while the scientist was conducting the experiment. (Algo deu errado enquanto o cientista estava conduzindo o experimento.)
Everyone was dancing at the party when the music stopped abruptly. (Todos estavam dançando na festa quando a música parou abruptamente.)

The project manager entered the room while the developers were debating the software architecture. (O gerente de projeto entrou na sala enquanto os desenvolvedores estavam debatendo a arquitetura do software.)
The marketing team was brainstorming new ideas when the fire alarm rang. (A equipe de marketing estava criando novas ideias quando o alarme de incêndio tocou.)
While the CEO was delivering her speech, the microphone stopped working. (Enquanto a CEO estava apresentando seu discurso, o microfone parou de funcionar.)
We were discussing the budget when the client asked for a discount. (Estávamos discutindo o orçamento quando o cliente pediu um desconto.)
The Wi-Fi disconnected while I was giving a virtual presentation. (O Wi-Fi desconectou enquanto eu estava fazendo uma apresentação virtual.)
The HR manager was reviewing résumés when her computer crashed. (A gerente de RH estava revisando currículos quando o computador dela travou.)
While the legal team was drafting the contract, they found a major error. (Enquanto a equipe jurídica estava redigindo o contrato, eles encontraram um erro grave.)
The delivery arrived while the warehouse staff was taking their lunch break. (A entrega chegou enquanto a equipe do armazém estava almoçando.)
Sarah was preparing the monthly report when she noticed a missing invoice. (Sarah estava preparando o relatório mensal quando notou a falta de uma fatura.)
They were negotiating the merger when the news leaked to the press. (Eles estavam negociando a fusão quando a notícia vazou para a imprensa.)
The lights were flickering while we were holding the board meeting. (As luzes estavam piscando enquanto estávamos realizando a reunião do conselho.)
The lights flickered while we were holding the board meeting. (As luzes piscaram enquanto estávamos realizando a reunião do conselho.)
While the intern was photocopying the documents, the machine jammed. (Enquanto o estagiário estava copiando os documentos, a máquina emperrou.)
I was checking my emails when I received the promotion offer. (Eu estava verificando meus e-mails quando recebi a oferta de promoção.)
